$comment: Each case names its own type: these are the definitions that are not objects, and one case per file would say less than one file per shape.

cases.name: closed enumeration, an undefined value
cases.why: the schema lists five and no others, so a sixth fails: a caller's switch was promised to be exhaustive

cases.name: closed enumeration, wrong JSON type
cases.why: a number is not one of the five either

cases.name: open string union, a listed value
open string union, an unlisted value
cases.why: the schema's last arm is a bare string, so this is valid and is kept exactly as received

cases.name: open string union, wrong JSON type
cases.why: open means any string, not any value

cases.name: bounded integer, at the top of the range
bounded integer, above the range
cases.why: the schema's maximum is a constraint, and the Go type chosen from the format enforces it

cases.name: bounded integer, below the range
cases.why: the same at the other end: the format is unsigned

cases.name: bounded integer, not an integer
cases.why: the format is an integer format

cases.name: identifier, any string
cases.why: the schema constrains a session id no further than to be a string
